Use case: compositing, precise local animation repair.
Image1 is the exact prepositioned next animation pose, F016. Image2 marks only the repair areas in pink. Image3 is the previously approved F008 figure, used only for the same identity, shirt fabric, color and flesh thickness; do NOT return to its upright pose. Do not render pink or text.
The elderly woman is firmly seated, deeply bending her whole torso forward to lower the SAME level basin almost to the floor. The pose and visible head, hair, face, glasses, original hands, jade bracelet, basin and bean pods are already precisely positioned. Keep these exactly, at the same size, orientation and location. The near LEFT hand wears jade and grips the front rim; the far RIGHT bare hand grips the rear rim. Never redraw or move their grip, basin or contents.
Repair the marked torso and arm connections into a complete hand-drawn figure. The flat blue and navy patches are temporary missing-surface guides: replace them with the same floral shirt and natural trouser folds as Image3, continuous with the genuine source-pixel fragments. Remove all old cut-out scraps, floating skin fragments, disconnected shirt edges and sharp collage spikes. Keep the original broad body volume and deep bend; form a natural waist-to-seated-hip junction. Her buttocks remain on the exact existing seat-support bottom, and shoes stay fixed. Do not straighten the back, raise the hips, or thin her waist.
The near upper arm emerges from the existing short sleeve and must connect smoothly through a full fleshy elbow to the existing downward forearm and original jade wrist. The near arm is IN FRONT OF the knee/trouser surface. Restore the exposed trousers behind it. The far arm runs BEHIND the torso and the near leg and is hidden; only the already positioned forearm/wrist emerges from the left front edge of the trousers and reaches the back rim. Do not draw a second visible arm over the pants, do not make an arm grow from the knee or chest, and do not create another hand. The basin is in front of the far shoe in this projection; the shoe itself is not moving.
Keep the whole 1024x1536 canvas, exact empty margins and subject placement. Preserve the original neutral watercolor-cartoon palette and outlines. Genuine transparent background. No stool, ground, cast shadow, extra objects, annotations or text. This is local completion of the given pose, not a new full-character drawing. Maintain the existing near-hand thumb at the rim and curled finger edges beneath it; the hand must read as supporting the basin, not as a flat palm pasted onto its wall. The bent waist needs convincing cloth volume between the back and the seated hips; clear all flat-fill spikes.
